results.title: Monaco marks Pink October with renewed push for early breast cancer screening
results.description: Breast cancer remains the most common cancer among women and the leading cause of cancer death, with one in eight women affected during her lifetime. As Pink October, the month dedicated to breast cancer awareness, gets underway, Monaco’s landmarks are set to be lit up pink on Saturday, October 3, as Pink Ribbon Monaco marks […] The post Monaco marks Pink October with renewed push for early breast cancer screening appeared first on NEWS.MC - Monaco News .
